name: week
title: The weekly operations review
subtitle: Read-only snapshot. Change records through your coding agent.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select register,title,owner,issue,detail from registers.attention order by issue,title

sections.title: Work by owner
sections.sql: select * from registers.workload order by overdue desc,owner

sections.title: Privacy record checks
sections.note: Review prompts, not a legal compliance certificate. Business dates are configured by the operator.
sections.sql: select register,title,rule,basis,finding from registers.compliance order by register,title

sections.title: Record inventory
sections.sql: select register,status,count(*)::int as records from registers.record_overview group by register,status order by register,status
